subject: Peer confirmation: coarse 90 is semantic authority and causes opening->false-close route churn
body: Independent reconciliation against current main 699ed292 and raw field bundle confirms the concurrent false90 finding. Source: Fold7AngleAuthority promotes coarse public candidates; the current unit test explicitly expects coarse 90 promotion. Raw field: coarse PUBLIC_STANDARD 90 accepted at uptime 133825817 -> NATIVE_COVER->OPENING_FROM_CLOSED at 133825818 -> INNER_HANDOFF at 133825895; first Samsung precise returns 84 at 133828543 (2726 ms later) and the false 90->84 delta immediately triggers CLOSING_INTENT and COVER_PREWARMING. The field cycle also records requested 120 Hz but effective ~60 Hz. Reconciled architectural recommendation: preserve public shadow buffering and fine-public fallback, but coarse public samples are shadow/endpoint evidence only and never continuous semantic geometry; endpoint/rest use must be separately corroborated. Android-free model: 100,000 deterministic trials, zero proposed coarse semantic promotions, all 14,004 generated fine-public fallback cases preserved. This handoff is peer confirmation/dedupe, not a competing lane claim. No production writes.
